name: Survey tile in Cancer
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Cancer, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 4 visits over 39 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 26 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 39 hours starting 2026-04-07, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.81 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
